title: quorum leg output — one plan
description: Structured output contract for a plan leg. Mirrors the fields in plan.md — do not add fields here without updating that prompt to match. All three legs share this shape; leg C emits it without schema enforcement and is parsed leniently.

summary.description: The approach in one short paragraph.

what.description: The change and how it is verified.

where.description: Files, repos, or systems touched — from the grounding pack when one exists.

depends_on.description: Titles of prior steps this one needs. Empty if none.

risk.description: What breaks, lands out of order, or is hard to reverse.

assumptions.description: Facts relied on that neither the brief nor the pack establishes, and ambiguities resolved by fiat.

open_questions.description: What must be answered before or during implementation, and by whom or from where.
